description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'Filter' for creating stream processing stages that filter messages based on type and predicate, using Akka Streams. It includes methods for filtering by class, predicate, and multiplexing messages via Either mappings.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create Akka Stream graph stages for filtering messages by type and predicate, including multiplexing capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a filtering graph stage based on message class and predicate, filtering messages of type T that satisfy the predicate.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a filtering graph stage based on message class, accepting all instances of T.

methods.name: multiplexBy
methods.description: Creates a graph that multiplexes messages into accepted and rejected streams based on an optional mapping function.

methods.name: multiplexByEither
methods.description: Creates a multiplexing graph using an Either mapper to separate accepted and rejected messages.

methods.name: multiplexByEitherFlow
methods.description: Creates a multiplexing graph from a flow that outputs Eithers, separating accepted and rejected messages.
